items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects four equivalent conditions: representability of the morphism by algebraic spaces, triviality of its second diagonal, triviality of the relative inertia group stack, and triviality of the kernel of the comparison map on isomorphism sheaves (author lemma at source lines 1700-1713, label lemma-second-diagonal). The proof (source lines 1715-1735) chains the characterisation of representability through faithfulness into the injectivity of the maps on isomorphism sheaves, identifies the kernel with a fibre product of the relative inertia, and disposes of the remaining equivalences by the triviality criterion for a group stack and by the identification of the kernel used in the inertia lemma (proof lines 1716-1734). The chain of translations between the four conditions is the content. H2.
